title: Request a copy of your NSW Driver Licence photo
summary: This page explains how to request a copy of your stored NSW Driver Licence photo by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro: If you'd like a copy of your stored NSW Driver Licence photo from Transport for NSW, please visit a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: your current NSW Driver Licence or Photo Card
the PDF form – 'Access to Own Personal Records'

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your request in person.

more_info.text: Once the request is processed, a hard copy of your photo will be sent to the service service.
You need to collect your photo in person, at the service centre.
